about: cc-P138: where our paperdoll gumps must sit on the bodies TazUO draws them over, and which bodies each gump serves. scripts\check-paperdoll-fit.py reads this; Build-PlayerPackage.ps1 runs it before staging. A body is a Siege of Sosaria body gump (vendor\paperdoll-sos\bodies-sfw, cc-P81), and TazUO picks it by the wearer's graphic (PaperDollInteractable.UpdateUI): 0x190/0x192 male human -> 12, 0x191/0x193 female human -> 13, 0x25D male elf -> 14, 0x25E female elf -> 15; the gargoyle bodies 665/666 are not served (KitsuneEarsTail refuses gargoyles). A worn item's gump is 60000 + animId for a woman and 50000 + animId for a man (GetAnimID), never by race, so one gump serves both the human and the elf body of its sex; the elf bodies have the same hips as the human ones and a crown row within one pixel (12 is row 29, 14 row 30; 13 and 15 row 33) (measured 2026-10-17, section 2 of the notes). Numbers are gump pixels (260 x 237 canvas, the same origin as the body). crown_y: the body's first opaque row. head_x: the head's widest span. face: a box the ears must stay out of (brow to chin). lower_back: the box the tail's root must start in (the hip at the viewer's left, where the tail leaves the body). The Topless and Nude add-on sets (never in a repo) are checked by silhouette against these same numbers when the folder exists.

64783.what: fox ears and tail, worn by a woman (60000 + Animation 4783)

54783.what: fox ears and tail, worn by a man (50000 + Animation 4783)
